title: Why American Portion Size Is Huge

cards.prompt: Name one reason American food portions are huge related to government policy.
cards.answer: The U.S. government heavily subsidizes and gives incentives to beef, grain, dairy and soy.

cards.prompt: Which cultural idea helps explain big portions?
options: Food shows hospitality, love and care
cards.answer: Giving food is a symbol of hospitality; a hungry guest reflects badly on the host.

cards.prompt: You visit an American host and leave hungry. How might that be seen?
cards.answer: As a shortcoming of the hostess for not providing enough food.
